\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Hello everyone, I'm a medical intern and recently started my medical posting.This blog is to share my experience and cases I came across during this period.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;60yr male came with\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;cheif complaints of giddiness since 3 days.and visual hallucinations since 3 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHOPI\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Pt was apparently asymptomatic 3 days back then he developed fever for 1 day for which he went to hospital and got treated and came back home ..then he developed giddiness only while walking , mostly swaying and unable to walk without support.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EVisual hallucinations are present ( seeing ciggretes in a plate asking wife to get them, perceives that his kids are sleeping with him and hiding something)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;No slurring of speech ,no vomitings no blurring of vision , tinnitus, no diplopia..\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E60\/M farmer previously now running tiffin shop since 10 years@miryalguda.chronic alcoholic,chronic smoker.k\/c\/o DM 2 since 9 years, regular medication and regular follow up\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; 2 yrs back ,1st episode of involuntary movements of all 4 limbs associated with uprolling of eye balls, frothing, lasting for 5 -10 mins , started on anti epileptic drug but pt used to get repeated seizure activity for every 2\/3 days-similar episodes .later on pt consulted neurologist in hyd and was put on 3 anti epileptic drugs ( lacosemide,carbamazepine,clobazam)continued for 4 months and stopped under medical supervision since then no seizure activity\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; 1 year back he went normally to work , suddenly developed weakness of both upper and lower limb..At that time slurring of speech and involuntary movements of\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;all 4 limbs present.loss of consciousness for about 1 min was present.. deviation of mouth to left side and post ictal confusion was present..? TIA .then they took him to the doctor,where MRI was done that showed subacute to chronic right capsuloganglionic bleed. \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003EHello everyone, I'm a medical intern, and recently started my Medicine posting. This blog is to share my experience and the cases I come across during this period.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cfont size=\"4\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003ECASE\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/font\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003EA 46 years old male patient came with complaint of chest pain for 30 minutes yesterday evening and shortness of breath on exertion.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cu\u003EHOPI\u003C\/u\u003E:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 5 years back then he developed pedal edema which was pitting type associated with abdominal distension and shortness of breath grade IV and got admitted outside hospital for 20 days and got discharged.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of chest pain, shortness of breath 3 years back and got admitted, angiogram was done and clot was removed, got discharged.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of similar complain 1 year back and got admitted at KIMS Narketpally.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EYesterday he complained of chest pain which was pricking type, radiating to left arm which lasted for 30 minutes and associated with sweating. No history of palpitations.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of shortness of breath on exertion (immediately after 3 to 4 steps) and relieved on
